profile.business: 3PL storing and shipping for 48 consumer brands

it.netsuite: read-only during pilot — agent never posts; it hands AP a ready-to-post list
it.writes: TMS and NetSuite are read-only to the agent; the only outputs are a reviewed list and an audit log
flow: Carrier invoices land in the AP mailbox (Microsoft 365). In the pilot the agent reads new PDFs with read-only mailbox access.
Claude reads each PDF into fields. The agent checks the read: lines add up to the total, the carrier is contracted, confidence is 0.85 or higher. If not, a person keys it.
The agent looks up the shipment and approved extras in the TMS and the contract lane — read-only API.
Fixed AP rules decide: contract base, fuel % of contract base, extras need TMS approval, never pay twice, over $2,500 needs a sign-off. Claude never decides pay or no-pay.
Clean invoices go on the ready-to-post list for AP. Everything else goes to a person with the reason and a recommendation.
safety: Pilot: sign-in with Microsoft SSO (Entra ID); only the AP group sees the queue.
Pilot: model runs on a US-region endpoint; invoices are not used to train models.
Read-only to TMS and NetSuite — the agent cannot change a shipment or post a bill.
Every read, decision, human override and export is logged with who and when.
If a carrier changes its layout or a total does not add up, the read check sends it to a person — never a guess.
demoVsPilot: Pilot: AP mailbox in Microsoft 365, read-only
Pilot: Claude on a US-region endpoint
Pilot: CSV or a NetSuite import file AP posts

peakFreeze.rule: No changes to live systems. Pilot runs in shadow mode or starts after the freeze.

metrics: Share of invoices cleared with no human touch (target set from week 1)
Dollars caught: overcharges plus duplicate and cancelled-shipment bills
Agent calls AP disagreed with — both missed problems and false flags
pilot.ask: Agree that it works on your data, fits your systems, and is safe — and start a 30-day shadow pilot now, live after Jan 5.
